title: 1638 Prairie's entrance, from its photograph
items: The Gothic house at 1638 Prairie now has the entrance its old photograph shows under the corner tower: a pointed arch on broad posts with a pierced quatrefoil in each corner, a glazed double door behind it, and steps up between two sloping cheek walls.
What the print could not settle — the opening's exact width and how many steps it really had — is written down as still open.
